description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katukurunda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520216
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple amendments to land titles for specific parcels of land in various locations (Katukurunda, Kirimatiya, Ampitiya Pallegama, Kehelwala, and Boyagama), providing detailed cadastral information including block numbers, map numbers, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions, and administrative divisions. The content focuses solely on land registration and title amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
